output.question: Who is Stripe's CTO?
output.answer: I found no public record that Stripe has named a CTO since Rahul Patil left the job. Patil had become CTO in August 2024 after David Singleton stepped down, then left to become Anthropic's CTO, announced October 7, 2025. Stripe's own newsroom leadership list does not include a CTO today. The closest technology executive on it is Will Gaybrick, whose title is President, Technology and Business. So the role looks vacant, or at least not publicly filled, but Stripe has not confirmed this.

key_facts.fact: Stripe's newsroom leadership list has no CTO. Will Gaybrick is listed as President, Technology and Business.
Rahul Patil joined Anthropic as CTO after serving as Stripe's CTO most recently.
Stripe promoted Rahul Patil to CTO, replacing David Singleton, who left after seven years.

passages.quote: guided the technical organization ... where he most recently served as CTO
Will Gaybrick: President, Technology and Business
After seven extraordinary years, I've decided it's time to try something new.

caveats: Stripe has not said anywhere I could find that the CTO role is vacant. The conclusion rests on two things: no successor announcement turned up, and the newsroom leadership list has no CTO.
Stripe may have filled the role internally without announcing it, or it may have moved those duties under Will Gaybrick.
Some third-party sites still name David Singleton or Rahul Patil as CTO. Those listings are out of date.
